about.title: About Macro Calculator - Macronutrient Distribution
about.description: The Macro Calculator estimates macronutrient distribution for protein, carbohydrates, and fats based on your goals, activity level, and selected inputs. It can be used to review different nutrition scenarios for weight maintenance, weight change, or training plans. Use the result as a general planning reference rather than an individualized medical or diet recommendation.

faq.q: What are macronutrients and why do they matter?
faq.a: Macronutrients are the three main nutrients your body needs in large amounts: protein (4 cal/g), carbohydrates (4 cal/g), and fats (9 cal/g). Each serves different functions - protein for muscle building and repair, carbs for energy, and fats for hormone production and nutrient absorption.

faq.q: How much protein do I need for my goals?
faq.a: Generally 0.8-1.2g per pound of body weight for sedentary individuals, and 1.2-2.2g per pound for active individuals and athletes. For muscle building, aim for the higher end (1.6-2.2g/lb), while maintenance can use moderate amounts (1.0-1.6g/lb).

faq.q: Should I track macros or just calories?
faq.a: Some people prefer tracking macros in addition to calories when they want a more detailed view of protein, carbohydrate, and fat intake. Whether that approach is useful depends on your goals, preferences, and how closely you want to plan meals.

faq.q: Can I adjust the macro ratios based on my preferences?
faq.a: Yes, macro ratios can be adjusted based on personal preferences, dietary restrictions, and how you want to structure meals. The calculator provides starting points you can review and modify as needed.
